title.zh: 大熊猫 · 中国山地的原生分布参考
title.en: Giant panda · a Chinese mountain-range reference

answer.zh: 大熊猫原生于中国部分有竹林的山地，包括四川。本条用中国的国家尺度教学锚点表示这一广义背景，不标出熊猫个体或保护区内的敏感地点。
answer.en: Giant pandas are native to parts of China's bamboo-bearing mountains, including Sichuan. This entry uses a country-scale teaching anchor for that broad context, not a panda or a sensitive locality within a reserve.

explanation.zh: 原资料明确使用Ailuropoda melanoleuca，并介绍中国山地森林中的竹林生境。动物需要的是合适生境，不是整个国家的每一处土地。图标位置由公开国家参考几何计算而来，既不证明锚点附近有熊猫，也不是其完整分布边界。
explanation.en: The source explicitly uses Ailuropoda melanoleuca and describes bamboo habitat in Chinese mountain forests. Suitable habitat matters; not every part of a country is occupied. The icon comes from public country reference geometry and proves neither panda presence near the anchor nor a complete range boundary.

timeNote.zh: 这是现代原生分布参考，2002是该账户自己的引用年份，不是野外观察日期、种群监测截至年份或大熊猫出现年代。与2025记录共用参考地图也不表示这是一条2025年目击。
timeNote.en: This is a modern native-range reference. 2002 is the account's own citation year, not a field-observation date, population-monitoring cutoff or origination age. Sharing a reference map with 2025 records does not make this a 2025 sighting.

text.zh: 该物种账户明确给出Ailuropoda melanoleuca，并将中国及四川列入其范围描述。
text.en: The species account explicitly names Ailuropoda melanoleuca and includes China and Sichuan in its range description.

text.zh: 国家尺度锚点来自Natural Earth中国参考多边形的项目自算近似质心，不来自熊猫观测坐标。
text.en: The country-scale anchor is a project-computed approximate centroid of Natural Earth's China reference polygon, not panda-observation coordinates.

caveats.zh: 这篇综述不是完整或最新分布清单；本条不采用其旧面积数值、省名全列表或种群判断，不把历史记载当作现在处处有熊猫。
caveats.en: This account is not a complete or latest range inventory. Its old area figures, full province list and population assessments are not adopted, and historical descriptions do not establish current presence everywhere.

caveats.zh: 不发布敏感个体、巢穴或观察点；国家质心可能不在实际栖息地，不能用于寻访动物。
caveats.en: No sensitive individuals, dens or observation points are published. A country centroid may be outside actual habitat and must not be used to locate animals.

caveats.zh: 原网页与图片只作私下来源核查；公开内容是原创双语说明与来源链接，没有借用未经许可的图片。
caveats.en: Source pages and images are not republished. Public content consists of original bilingual text and source links, with no uncleared photographs.

name.zh: 中国 · 国家尺度安全教学锚点
name.en: China · a safe country-scale teaching anchor

precision.zh: 公开简化国家参考多边形的等积球面近似质心，坐标仅保留一位小数。这是安全教学区域锚点，不是熊猫目击、个体位置、保护区坐标或分布边界；实测位置误差不适用且未量化。
precision.en: A spherical equal-area approximate centroid of a public simplified country reference polygon, rounded to one decimal degree. This is a safe regional teaching anchor, not a panda sighting, individual, reserve coordinate or range boundary; measured positional uncertainty is not applicable and is unquantified.

title.zh: 老虎 · 亚洲原生范围的印度参考
title.en: Tiger · an Indian reference within its Asian native range

answer.zh: 虎的原生背景在亚洲，印度属于所引资料明确列出的范围。本例用印度的国家尺度锚点，不把它当成某只虎的当前位置，也不表示印度全境都有虎。
answer.en: Tigers have an Asian native context, and India is explicitly included by the cited source. This example uses a country-scale Indian anchor, not a tiger's current location or a claim of presence throughout India.

explanation.zh: 原账户使用Panthera tigris，描述多种森林、灌丛及高草生境。这里只采用亚洲及印度的广义原生背景，不沿用旧亚种清单、旧种群稳定性判断或所有历史国家记录。公开国家参考几何只决定示意图标放在哪里，不决定虎实际生活在哪里。
explanation.en: The account uses Panthera tigris and describes forest, scrub and tall-grass habitats. Only broad Asian and Indian native context is adopted, not old subspecies lists, population-stability assessments or every historical country record. Public country geometry determines an illustrative icon, not where tigers actually live.

timeNote.zh: 2007是物种账户的真实引用年份，不是观察、监测或出现年代。本条没有日期区间，也不是2025年的虎数量、分布测绘或实时位置。
timeNote.en: 2007 is the species account's actual citation year, not an observation, monitoring or origination date. This entry has no date interval and is not a 2025 tiger count, range survey or live location.

text.zh: Panthera tigris原账户的范围描述明确涉及亚洲及印度。
text.en: The Panthera tigris account's range description explicitly includes Asian context and India.

text.zh: 印度锚点为公开国家参考多边形的近似质心，不由野外虎监测位置推定。
text.en: The Indian anchor is an approximate public country-polygon centroid, not an inference from wild tiger-monitoring locations.

caveats.zh: 广义国家范围不等于连续栖息地、完整现存分布或每个年份均有虎；本条不评估各亚种当前现况。
caveats.en: A broad country reference is not continuous habitat, a complete present range or proof of presence in every year. Current subspecies status is not assessed here.

caveats.zh: 不提供敏感观察点、个体GPS或动物园位置；质心可能不在虎栖息地，不能作为寻找动物的线索。
caveats.en: No sensitive sightings, individual GPS or zoo positions are provided. The centroid may be outside tiger habitat and is not a clue for finding animals.

caveats.zh: 原文和照片许可没有据此获得；只发布自写说明与引用链接，位置误差未知而不是零误差。
caveats.en: No source-text or photograph rights are acquired here. Only original explanations and citations are published, and positional uncertainty is unknown, not zero.

precision.en: A spherical equal-area approximate centroid of a public simplified country reference polygon, rounded to one decimal degree. A safe regional teaching anchor only, not a tiger sighting, individual GPS, reserve coordinate or range boundary; positional uncertainty is unquantified.

title.zh: 狮子 · 非洲原生背景的南非参考
title.en: Lion · a South African reference within its African native context

answer.zh: 狮子的原生背景包括非洲部分草原与稀树草原；所引资料明确提及南非的保护区，另有印度吉尔森林的亚洲狮。本例只用南非国家尺度示意，不把狮子限定为只原生于一个国家。
answer.en: Lions have a native context in parts of Africa's plains and savannas. The source explicitly mentions South African protected areas and also Asiatic lions in India's Gir forest. This example uses a South African country-scale illustration, not a claim of nativeness in only one country.

explanation.zh: 原账户的科学名是Panthera leo，地理段落区分非洲背景与印度吉尔森林。这里不重新裁定旧亚种分类，也不把历史上更广的范围当作今日处处仍有狮子。国家质心不是某个国家公园、狮群领地或动物园的坐标。
explanation.en: The account's scientific name is Panthera leo, and its geography distinguishes African context from India's Gir forest. Old subspecies classifications are not resolved here, nor is a wider historical range treated as current presence everywhere. The country centroid is not a national park, pride territory or zoo coordinate.

timeNote.zh: 2004来自账户自己的引用信息，表示资料年份，不是狮子观察或种群监测年份。现代示意没有calendar区间，不会因为地图入口叫2025就变成2025目击记录。
timeNote.en: 2004 comes from the account's own citation and is a source year, not a lion observation or population-monitoring year. This modern illustration has no calendar interval and does not become a 2025 sighting because of the map entry's label.

text.zh: Panthera leo范围段落明确说明非洲背景、南非保护区及印度吉尔森林。
text.en: The Panthera leo range paragraph explicitly describes African context, South African protected areas and India's Gir forest.

text.zh: 南非图标来自公开国家参考几何的近似质心，不来自狮子观察、圈养展出或引入地点。
text.en: The South African icon is an approximate public country-geometry centroid, not a lion observation, captive display or introduction site.

caveats.zh: 本条不是最新完整分布图或现存数量评估；历史范围、保护区存在及当前全国占据范围不能互相替代。
caveats.en: This is not a latest complete range map or abundance assessment. Historical range, presence in protected areas and current country-wide occupancy are not interchangeable.

caveats.zh: 国家尺度锚点可能落在非栖息地；不表示锚点附近有狮子，不是领地边界，也不采用动物园或人为引入区证明原生范围。
caveats.en: A country-scale anchor may lie outside habitat. It establishes no lions near the anchor or territory boundary, and zoos or introduced areas do not establish native range.

caveats.zh: 原网页、原文与图片只私下核查，不随公开数据包发布；只使用原创双语解释与来源链接。
caveats.en: Source pages, text and images remain private verification artifacts, not public-package content. Only original bilingual explanations and links are used.

precision.en: A spherical equal-area approximate centroid of a public simplified country reference polygon, rounded to one decimal degree. A regional teaching illustration, not a lion sighting, pride position, national-park coordinate or range boundary; not a surveyed animal locality, with unknown uncertainty.

title.zh: 平原斑马 · 东南非洲的坦桑尼亚参考
title.en: Plains zebra · a Tanzanian reference in southeastern Africa

answer.zh: 平原斑马原生于非洲东部及南部的部分地区，所引物种页明确提到肯尼亚与坦桑尼亚。本例选坦桑尼亚国家尺度锚点，不以资料机构的动物园位置表示野外范围。
answer.en: Plains zebras are native to parts of eastern and southern Africa, and the cited species page explicitly mentions Kenya and Tanzania. This example uses a Tanzanian country-scale anchor, not the source institution's zoo location as wild range.

explanation.zh: 这里的科学名是Equus quagga，对象是现生平原斑马，不把山斑马、细纹斑马或已灭绝的半身斑马资料混成同一个现生范围。国家锚只帮助辨认广义区域，不表示坦桑尼亚全境都有斑马，更不是某一群动物的迁移位置。
explanation.en: The scientific name is Equus quagga and the subject is living plains zebra. Mountain zebra, Grevy's zebra and extinct-quagga accounts are not merged into its modern range. The country anchor identifies broad context, not presence throughout Tanzania or the migration position of a herd.

timeNote.zh: 物种页没有可核实的文章年份，因此referenceYear为unknown/null；页脚©2026不是文章或野外记录日期。本条不是2025观测、监测或实时分布。
timeNote.en: No verifiable article year is stated, so referenceYear is unknown/null. Footer copyright 2026 is not an article or field-record date. This is not a 2025 observation, monitoring record or live distribution.

text.zh: SANBI物种页明确将Plains Zebra对应为Equus quagga，野外范围段落明确提及坦桑尼亚。
text.en: The SANBI species page explicitly identifies Plains Zebra as Equus quagga and names Tanzania in its wild-range paragraph.

text.zh: 锚点由坦桑尼亚公开国家参考多边形计算，不来自动物园、引入区或斑马目击坐标。
text.en: The anchor is computed from Tanzania's public country reference polygon, not a zoo, introduced area or zebra-sighting coordinates.

caveats.zh: 仅按资料支持广义原生区域，不声称完整最新分布边界、群体数量或所有地区持续占据。
caveats.en: Only broad source-supported native context is shown, not complete latest range boundaries, herd counts or continuous occupancy everywhere.

caveats.zh: 已拒绝把标题为quagga、正文明确灭绝的旧ADW页面当作本条现代平原斑马证据。
caveats.en: The old ADW page titled quagga and explicitly describing extinction was rejected as evidence for this modern plains-zebra entry.

caveats.zh: 只有原创解释与来源链接公开；原页声明保留版权，未获取照片或其他原文的再发布许可。
caveats.en: Only original explanations and links are public. The source reserves copyright, and no photographs or source-text republication rights were obtained.

precision.en: A spherical equal-area approximate centroid of a public simplified country reference polygon, rounded to one decimal degree. A regional teaching anchor only, not a zebra sighting, herd migration point, zoo location or native-range boundary; uncertainty is unquantified.

title.zh: 红大袋鼠 · 澳大利亚大陆的干旱区参考
title.en: Red kangaroo · a mainland Australian arid-zone reference

answer.zh: 红大袋鼠的原生范围包括澳大利亚大陆的干旱及半干旱地区。本条采用Australian Museum当前页面的Osphranter rufus用名，并透明保留旧资料中的Macropus rufus名称背景。
answer.en: Red kangaroos are native to arid and semi-arid regions of mainland Australia. This entry follows Australian Museum's current Osphranter rufus usage and transparently retains the Macropus rufus naming background of older references.

explanation.zh: Museum页面明确给出Osphranter rufus与澳洲大陆干旱、半干旱范围。独立名称核查显示，本次GBIF分类响应仍接受Macropus rufus，并将Osphranter rufus作为指向该同一条目的同义用名；这体现资料命名体系差异，不是两种不同袋鼠。本稿按指定名展示，不伪称所有资料库已统一接受名。
explanation.en: The Museum explicitly gives Osphranter rufus and an arid/semi-arid mainland Australian range. Independent name checks show the captured GBIF backend still accepting Macropus rufus and treating Osphranter rufus as a synonym pointing to that same entry. This reflects naming-system differences, not two different kangaroos. The requested display name is retained without claiming universal database agreement.

timeNote.zh: 2026是Museum页面实际更新年份；其元数据另标2015首次发表，两者都不是野外观察日。本条没有calendar区间、出现年代或野外数量，也不是2025监测或实时定位。
timeNote.en: 2026 is the Museum page's actual update year; its metadata separately states first publication in 2015. Neither is a field-observation date. This entry has no calendar interval, origination age or wild count and is not 2025 monitoring or live tracking.

text.zh: Australian Museum的Taxon元数据使用Osphranter rufus，正文范围为澳大利亚大陆干旱及半干旱地区。
text.en: Australian Museum's Taxon metadata uses Osphranter rufus, and its range text specifies arid and semi-arid mainland Australia.

text.zh: 两个GBIF精确名称响应以acceptedUsageKey／usageKey 5219963明确连接Osphranter rufus与该系统使用的Macropus rufus；不把该分类标志扩成跨机构共识。
text.en: Two exact GBIF name responses explicitly connect Osphranter rufus with that backend's Macropus rufus through acceptedUsageKey/usageKey 5219963; its classification flag is not extended into institutional consensus.

text.zh: 澳大利亚锚点来自公开国家参考几何，不来自袋鼠观察位置或Museum标本采集地点。
text.en: The Australian anchor comes from public country reference geometry, not kangaroo sightings or Museum specimen-collection localities.

caveats.zh: 澳大利亚国家锚不表示所有澳洲地区或岛屿都有红大袋鼠；资料描述限定为大陆适宜的干旱、半干旱背景。
caveats.en: An Australian country anchor does not establish red kangaroos throughout every region or island. The account specifies suitable arid and semi-arid mainland context.

caveats.zh: 这是红大袋鼠的具体物种参考，不把所有袋鼠合并成Osphranter rufus，也不借动物园或引入区证明原生范围。
caveats.en: This is a species-specific red-kangaroo reference, not all kangaroos merged into Osphranter rufus, and zoos or introduced areas do not establish native range.

caveats.zh: 旧名与指定展示名的原源用法均保留；不以名称连接认证某个个体、树叶或完整谱系。
caveats.en: Original source usage of both the older name and requested display name is retained. Name linkage does not certify an individual, tree tip or complete lineage.

caveats.zh: 只发布自写双语文字和链接，不下载或公开Museum照片、标本扫描或未知许可正文；锚点误差未知。
caveats.en: Only original bilingual text and links are published. No Museum photographs, specimen scans or uncleared source text are downloaded or republished; anchor uncertainty is unknown.

name.zh: 澳大利亚 · 国家尺度教学锚点

precision.zh: 公开简化国家参考多边形的等积球面近似质心，保留一位小数。教学区域示意而非红大袋鼠目击、个体或标本采集位置、迁移点或分布边界；不是实测动物地点，误差未知。
precision.en: A spherical equal-area approximate centroid of a public simplified country reference polygon, rounded to one decimal degree. A regional teaching illustration, not a red-kangaroo sighting, individual or specimen-collection locality, migration point or range boundary; not a surveyed animal location, with unknown uncertainty.

caption.zh: Laetoli足迹复制品，藏于东京国立科学博物馆；Momotarou2012摄于2013年。它展示约366万年前足迹的形态，不是坦桑尼亚遗址现场照片。
caption.en: Replica of the Laetoli footprints at the National Museum of Nature and Science, Tokyo, photographed by Momotarou2012 in 2013. It illustrates traces dating to about 3.66 million years ago, not the original Tanzanian site.

caption.zh: Immanuelle摄于2018年的Göbekli Tepe遗址照片，可见T形石柱和石砌结构；不是公元前9600至8200年的实景或完整复原。
caption.en: Immanuelle's 2018 photograph of Göbekli Tepe shows exposed T-shaped pillars and stone structures. It is a modern site photograph, not a contemporary scene or complete reconstruction of 9600-8200 BCE.
